notes.title: The House Always Wins – But Not on Steam
notes.content:
[h2]🎲 Hello my friends![/h2]

My first game on Steam, [b]Hit and Stand Blackjack[/b], is here to teach you a valuable life lesson:

[quote][b]The only way to be sure you don't lose… is to not play.[/b][/quote]

Blackjack, in general, is a game where [i]the house always has the edge[/i].

[b]But winners don't gamble with real money[/b]💸.  
If you're going to play Blackjack – do it safely, do it for fun, do it with [b]Hit and Stand Blackjack[/b]. 😉

[b]Stats no one asked for (but Steam tracks anyway):[/b] 📊
[list]
[*]Revenue: $0 💸  
[*]Players: A few brave souls 😂
[*]Median playtime: 9 glorious minutes 🎉  
[/list]

But hey, at least it's free! 😎  
Come join the club – and maybe you'll even stay for a 10th minute.

And if you [i]do[/i] end up playing:  
💬 [b]Every review – serious, silly, or somewhere in between – is genuinely appreciated.[/b]  
It lets me know someone out there actually clicked “Play.” 🎮

[quote]
[b]Hit smart.[/b]  
[b]Stand proud.[/b]  
 [b]Or just close the game. That works too.[/b]😉
[/quote]

[h3]🎉 Bonus news:[/h3]  
A small update is coming [b]later this month[/b] – so small you probably won’t even notice it.  
But hey, that’s part of the magic.

notes.title: Achievement Fix + Save Settings Overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]Upcoming Patch – Achievement Fixes, New Music & Settings Reset[/h1]
Hi everyone!

A new update is scheduled to go live on 🗓️ 2025-05-22 at 20:00 (CET / Swedish time).

Thanks so much for your patience — I’ve been away on a short holiday for a few days, but I’m back now and ready to roll out an important update.

This patch addresses a number of issues with the Achievement system, adds new music, and resets the way settings are saved — which helps support multiple users more reliably going forward.

[h1] What’s Changing[/h1]
"Quit While Ahead" was not unlocking correctly for some players due to a bug where the system missed the unlock trigger. This has been fixed.

The Achievement Manager now automatically syncs with Steam every 5 minutes — so if an achievement doesn’t register right away, it will be retried in the background.

A final sync now runs when you quit the game, ensuring any just-earned achievements are sent to Steam before the game exits.

Achievements and stats are now saved per Steam user on your computer, meaning if you switch Steam accounts, the system won’t grant achievements that were earned by someone else.

Offline play is supported — achievements will be saved locally and synced the next time you’re online.

🎵 Two new background music tracks have been added!

⚠️ Settings Reset Warning
To support proper per-user saving, the system has changed.
As a result, the following settings will be reset for all players after the update:

Language
Difficulty level.
Music volume.
Total game time counter. (This refers to in-game time used for the “One Hour” achievement — not your total Steam playtime.)

Sorry for the inconvenience — this is a one-time change that ensures future saves are more robust and Steam-aware.

🚀 The update will go live today, May 22 at 20:00 Swedish time (CEST).

notes.title: Thank you for your support!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for downloading my first game!

Right now, I’m closely watching player feedback and data to understand how the game is performing and how I can improve it.

If you have any thoughts, please leave an honest review, especially if you run into any issues. I want to make the game better, and your feedback really helps me know what to fix or improve.

Thanks again for trying Hit and Stand Blackjack!
